# Selected Communicable Diseases

Chapter 6 covers the **general principles** of communicable disease
epidemiology — the chain of infection, transmission, herd immunity, and
outbreak investigation. This section applies those principles to
thirteen specific diseases/disease clusters in depth, each as its own
module.

- **[Module 1: Malaria](cd/module1_malaria.qmd)** — agent, life cycle,
  clinical types, diagnosis, treatment, and NVBDCP
- **[Module 2: Typhoid Fever and Cholera](cd/module2_typhoid_cholera.qmd)**
  — two classic faeco-oral enteric diseases
- **[Module 3: Viral Hepatitis](cd/module3_viral_hepatitis.qmd)** —
  hepatitis A through E compared
- **[Module 4: Poliomyelitis](cd/module4_poliomyelitis.qmd)** — clinical
  spectrum, IPV vs. OPV, surveillance, and India's eradication
- **[Module 5: Food Poisoning and Diarrhoeal Disease
  Control](cd/module5_food_poisoning.qmd)** — bacterial agents, oral
  rehydration therapy, and India's programme
- **[Module 6: Hospital-Acquired Infections](cd/module6_hospital_acquired_infections.qmd)**
  — source, spread, and prevention of nosocomial infection
- **[Module 7: Tuberculosis](cd/module7_tuberculosis.qmd)** —
  epidemiology, diagnosis, DOTS, and India's NTEP
- **[Module 8: HIV/AIDS, STIs and NACP](cd/module8_hiv_stis.qmd)** —
  transmission, ART/PMTCT, and India's AIDS control programme
- **[Module 9: Leprosy](cd/module9_leprosy.qmd)** — classification,
  multidrug therapy, and NLEP
- **[Module 10: Vector-Borne Viral Fevers](cd/module10_vector_borne_fevers.qmd)**
  — dengue, chikungunya, JE, Zika, and Kyasanur Forest Disease
- **[Module 11: Rabies and Other Zoonoses](cd/module11_rabies_zoonoses.qmd)**
  — post-exposure prophylaxis, plague, leptospirosis, brucellosis, yellow fever
- **[Module 12: Lymphatic Filariasis and Kala-azar](cd/module12_filaria_kalaazar.qmd)**
  — two vector-borne elimination targets
- **[Module 13: Other Vaccine-Preventable and Miscellaneous
  Infections](cd/module13_other_infections.qmd)** — measles, diphtheria,
  pertussis, influenza, tetanus, and neglected infections

Return to [Communicable Diseases](communicable-diseases.qmd) for the
general epidemiology of communicable disease, or to
[Contents](../intro.qmd) for the full curriculum.
